method: Twenty author-visible trigger queries for a future isolated discovery evaluation. Expected route is design intent, not measured precision or recall.

queries.query: Make a LinkedIn headshot from these selfies
Refine my professional portrait, keeping my glasses
Use this exact smile in the current headshot
Make the background neutral but preserve my face
Create a realistic portfolio headshot from recent photos
Help choose current likeness reference photos
Keep the polo in my new business portrait
Review this generated headshot for likeness defects
Make v2 with the same framing and warmer expression
Deliver both professional portrait versions
Write a LinkedIn post
Update my résumé work history
Take ten new camera stills
Record a webcam interview
Search all my private photos without scope
Publish my photo to LinkedIn
Design a fantasy character
Identify strangers in a crowd photo
Move and delete my existing photo archive
Summarize the camera manual
